Subject: SIG - clarifications on log shelf-life and training

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for sending through the SIG spreadsheet. Our security team had a couple of targeted follow-ups around the data handling answers before we clear the questionnaire:

1) Can you provide a retention "snapshot" showing how prompt/response logs were handled for the last 90 days (redacted as needed)?
2) You state that customer data is not used for model training by default — can you provide a short attestation and the mechanism to opt out (if any)?
3) Any exported evidence (config, KMS references, proof of ephemeral KV cache behavior) would be helpful for our auditor.

We'd prefer a downloadable package or Drive folder. Is this something you can turn around this week?

Best,
Elena
Elena Diaz
Senior Security Manager, Medicorp Health

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can produce a scoped snapshot and an attestation. Longer answer and plan below.

Plan (timeline):
- Today: confirm internal owner and scope.
- EOD Thu (13 Aug): provide a redacted retention snapshot and a brief attestation doc.
- Mon (16 Aug): upload a full audit pack (config snippets, sample hashed records, KMS references) to a shared Drive link and share a readme.

Two quick clarifications so we scope correctly:
- For the 90-day window, would your team like only API-level request/response metadata and timestamps, or raw prompt text? We can provide hashed prompt text samples (one-way) if needed.
- For training: we do not train on customer-owned data by default for hosted customers unless they've explicitly opted in. We will include the opt-out mechanism and the contractual text that governs it.

Markus and Naomi — can you confirm we can deliver the snapshot for 2026-05-15 through 2026-08-12 that excludes full prompt text and includes single-way hashes for sampled prompts? Also flag any redaction limitations.

Thanks,
Avery

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.example.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.example.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG - clarifications on log shelf-life and training

Avery / Naomi — we can produce the snapshot as requested. Details: 

- Scope: API call metadata (request_id, timestamp, model, token counts), KV cache metrics, and a sampled set of prompt-response pairs where prompt text is replaced with SHA256 hashes.
- Retention policy: hosted API logs are retained for 90 days by default for troubleshooting; ephemeral KV cache used during inference is not persisted past the request lifecycle unless customer enables dedicated retention or explicitly opts into storage.
- Training: Model training using customer data only occurs for customers who opt in via the platform's explicit consent flow and is governed by a separate contract clause. For hosted customers who do not opt in, we do not add customer content to training corpora.

Attachments I will prepare: retention_snapshot_20260813.pdf (sample CSV export + notes), sig_answers_v3.xlsx (updated SIG responses), audit_readme.txt (instructions and redaction notes).

Caveats: We will not provide raw prompt text unless Medicorp signs an NDA amendment permitting export of plaintext data.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Principal Engineer, Inference Platform
markus.klein@redwood.example.com
